newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-WARNE PUTS BRAKES ON ENGLAND FIGHTBACK.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WARNE PUTS BRAKES ON ENGLAND FIGHTBACK.

text.p: Shane Warne was again the scourge of England on Friday, taking three wickets in 40 balls to put the brakes on the home team's fightback in the fifth test.
England ended the second day on 188 for four -- 239 behind Australia's first innings score.
Openers Michael Atherton (27) and Alec Stewart (87) put on 106 but both fell to the Warne-Ian Healy combination.

The veteran wicketkeeper then passed 300 test dismissals as he caught John Crawley for 18 off the bowling of Glenn McGrath and leg spinner Warne captured his third wicket by bowling Nasser Hussain for two.
Earlier, Australia, resuming at 302 for three, had lost their last seven wickets for 125. Dean Headley took four for 87.
